title: Board View with no technicians shows "No technicians yet" with the new text
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new location for this test, location C, in the same organization, where no enrolled staff member is a technician (every staff member enrolled there has Technician off), so the board there has no technician.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at location C, in Approved, led by nobody (no lead), so the open tab has a work order.
  • Make sure neither Assigned to me nor a Technician filter is on.
  • Switch to location C.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The board shows the title "No technicians yet" with the text "Turn Technician on for your technicians in Staff to assign work orders. Until then, every work order stays in Unassigned."
  • No technician column shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S3-R10: “When Board View or Tech View has no technician column or group at all (no technician at the location, no column kept for a non-technician lead under S3-E1 and no pinned column under S3-E2), and neither Assigned to me nor a Technician filter is on, it shows the title "No technicians yet" with the text "Turn Technician on for your technicians in Staff to assign work orders. Until then, every work order stays in Unassigned." When the open tab has no work orders either, the "Nothing here yet" state keeps its title, and its text reads "Turn Technician on for your technicians and create your first work order to track work by tech." The button the Board View and Tech View PRD (S1-N1d, SV-11555) calls Add Technician reads "Set Up Technicians" and opens the staff list (Settings, Staff), for the same users who see it today. This replaces S1-N1d's text and button target once this feature ships.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "5 Board View and Tech View" (the empty state is not drawn, register TT-N12); design system library ds/shopview/components.css, section EMPTY STATE

The design's own words:

  • “One rule for every empty state in the product: ONE icon from the set, a title, at most one sentence, and the action that fills it.”

Difference: the design system the canvas uses allows at most one sentence; S3-R10 gives two (register TT-D04, PO question 7). This case follows the PRD and is held.
